Uses of Package
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client

Packages that use com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client
Package
Description
com.jasonwjones.di
Public client API for the unofficial Data Management (DM/AIF) REST service, a separate service from the main PBCS/Planning REST API used for jobs and application/dimension metadata that the Planning API doesn't expose.
com.jasonwjones.di.impl
Default implementation of the Data Management (DM/AIF) client API.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs
Root package for the PBJ client library.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.api.v3.dataslices
Maps the request/response payloads used to export and import data slices (grids of cell data), plus a GridDefinitionBuilder for constructing requests.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client
The main public API for the PBCS/EPM Cloud Planning REST API: PbcsPlanningClient for the connection, PbcsApplication for an application, PbcsPlanType for a cube, and PbcsMember for outline members.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.exceptions
Exceptions thrown by this library's Planning REST API client, rooted at PbcsClientException.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl
Default implementation of the com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client API.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.export
Callback implementations and options for printing an export in various text formats (fixed-width, Markdown), for use with PbcsPlanType.ExportCallback.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.grid
A PovGrid view over a data slice response, plus a plain-text printer for it.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.interceptors
RestTemplate request interceptors used internally to attach credentials/tokens and log requests and responses.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.membervisitors
PlanTypeWalker.Visitor implementations that collect members matching a MemberSearchQuery while walking a plan type's dimension hierarchy, in support of PbcsPlanType.searchMembers(com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.MemberSearchQuery).
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.memberdimensioncache
Pluggable caching strategies for member/dimension lookups and aliases, implementing PbcsPlanType.MemberDimensionCache and PbcsPlanType.MemberResolver.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.interop.impl
Default implementation of InteropClient, plus the application snapshot models (ApplicationSnapshot, ApplicationSnapshotInfo) it returns.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.util
Public utility classes for working with grids and plan type dimensions: printing and diffing data slices (GridPrinter, DataSliceDiff), walking a dimension hierarchy (PlanTypeWalker), and building test fixtures or sample connections (TextGridReader, PbcsClientUtils).

    Class
    Description
    Grid
    A simple two-dimensional grid of cells, addressed by zero-based row and column index.
    MemberSearchQuery
    Defines a query to be executed by the PbcsPlanType.searchMembers(MemberSearchQuery) method.
    MemberSearchQuery.Type
    Different types of searches that can be performed.
    PbcsApi
    Simple model for current REST API information
    PbcsAppDimension
    An "app dimension" extends from a normal PbcsDimension object and is slightly specialized with additional methods such as which plans (cubes) it is valid for.
    PbcsApplication
    Models a PBCS application such as a Planning or an HFM application.
    PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
    The number of overloads of PbcsApplication.getPlanType(String) started to proliferate, so there is now a generic configuration object where the plan definition is specified and then passed to the PbcsApplication.getPlanType(PlanTypeConfiguration) method.
    PbcsAppType
    Models the application type.
    PbcsDimension
    Represents a dimension in terms of a Data Management dimension (as opposed to a particular instance of a dimension in an application/plan type).
    PbcsJobDefinition
    Represents a job definition that exists in the application.
    PbcsJobStatus
    Model for a job that is executed on a PBCS server.
    PbcsJobStatusCode
    The numeric job status codes returned by the PBCS REST API for a launched job.
    PbcsJobType
    The known job types returned by the REST API's job definitions endpoint.
    PbcsMember
    The member response from the PBCS REST API contains some properties that have been added over the years are not currently mapped in.
    PbcsMember.DataStorage
    Models the possible data storage types.
    PbcsMemberQueryType
    Models different types of queries that can be performed by a PbcsPlanType.queryMembers(String, PbcsMemberQueryType) operation.
    PbcsMemberType
    Types are in HSP_OBJECT_TYPE.
    PbcsObject
    Base interface for objects modeled by this library that map to (or are synthesized on top of) PBCS/EPM Cloud entities, providing common name, parent, and type accessors.
    PbcsObjectType
    Enumeration for various objects that exist in PBCS system.
    PbcsPlanningClient
    Main interface for interacting with the PBCS service.
    PbcsPlanType
    Represents a particular plan type (cube) contained as part of a PbcsApplication.
    PbcsPlanType.CellNotesOption
    The available options for handling existing cell notes during a data import.
    PbcsPlanType.ExportCallback
    A callback that can be used with the PbcsPlanType.export(PbcsPov, String, DimensionMembers, ExportCallback) method for exporting a flat set of data from a cube.
    PbcsPlanType.ImportDataOptions
    Represents all the options that can be used on the importDataSlice REST endpoint.
    PbcsPlanType.ImportDataResult
    Represents the results of importing data to the plan/cube.
    PbcsPlanType.MemberDimensionCache
    A member dimension cache is a simple cache that caches the dimension for member names.
    PbcsPlanType.MemberResolver
    An elaboration of the PbcsPlanType.MemberDimensionCache that offers more sophistication than just resolving the dimension for a given member.
    PbcsPlanType.RetrieveOptions
    Options for performing a retrieve.
    PbcsPov
    Represents a POV (i.e., a single fully qualified cell address).
    PovGrid
    A Grid that additionally carries a POV (point of view) for the dimensions not represented on either axis.
